item.title: Mexican Sopes with Picadillo Topping
item.description: Sopes are a classic in Mexican cuisine: thick corn cakes made from masa harina that are lightly fried for a soft but slightly crispy texture. We topped ours with a hearty veggie picadillo, a dish traditionally made with ground meat, tomatoes, and a mix of vegetables and spices, but here given a plant-based twist. item.title: Pizza Margherita with Homemade 'Mozzarella'
item.description: The star of this pizza is the homemade vegan mozzarella, which remains beautifully soft and melts perfectly when baked. It enhances the dish with its blend of savoury, umami, and cheesy flavours.

item.title: Garraettok with Saucy Minced 'Meat'
item.description: For this dish, we took inspiration from different Asian cuisines to create a salty, umami sauce that is served over chewy rice cake sticks. This type of rice cake is known as "garae-tteok" (가래떡) and is most commonly known from the popular Korean dish "tteokbokki" (떡볶이).

item.title: Chickpea Brownie Batter
item.description: A rich, fudgy brownie batter made with chickpeas that’s meant to be enjoyed as-is. Chocolatey, satisfying, and surprisingly wholesome, perfect for spooning, dipping, or spreading.

item.title: Herbs of Provence Infused Salt
item.description: Herbs of Provence salt is a versatile blend of Mediterranean herbs and salt. Use it to enhance the flavour of roasted vegetables, salad dressings, marinades, or spreads. It is a very aromatic blend, with a subtle lavender note, that will elevate your dishes in a simple way. It is also a great blend to prepare as gift.

item.title: Easter Egg Shortbread Thumbprint Cookies
item.description: Celebrate Easter with these fun egg-shaped shortbread cookies! They’re easy to make, come together with just a handful of simple everyday ingredients, and look like they came straight from a bakery. The glossy jam centres shine like little gems nestled in each cookie. Use apricot jam for a classic egg-like look, or raspberry jam for a fun pop of colour.

item.title: Toasted Spaghetti Bolognese
item.description: Elevate a simple, classic dish by toasting the pasta before cooking, which imparts a mild, almost nutty flavour. This dish is a mix of textures—a perfect fusion of firm yet tender pasta strands, chewy veggie ground, and a flawlessly seasoned tomato sauce. It's a cozy one-pot dish that is easy to prepare on a busy weekday night.
